newsitem.title: INDIA: India Greaves down after Q1 sales drop.
newsitem.headline: India Greaves down after Q1 sales drop.

text.p: Shares of Indian engineering firm Greaves Ltd slumped 6.0 rupees, or nearly 10 percent, to 55.0 rupees at the Bombay bourse on Thursday after the firm reported a drop in 1997/98 first quarter sales, dealers said.
The engineering arm of the Thapar group on Wednesday reported a 15 percent drop in sales in the first quarter ending June 30, 1997.
Local newspapers quoted the company as saying that lack of investments in Indian infrastructure projects and a slowdown in the economy contributed to the drop in first quarter sales.
The company has however said it expected investments in infrastructure to show a gradual rise during the second half of 1997/98 (April-March).
Greaves has earmarked a capital expenditure plan of 680 million rupees over the next two years.
